title: Siege of Laholm Castle
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Laholm Castle", at revision 1370742747, opens: "The siege of Laholm Castle occurred from 2 to 15 May 1644 during Gustav Horn's invasion of Scania, as part of the Torstenson War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q139073614, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "part of the Torstenson War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
